title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager in healthcare oversees the daily operations and administrative functions of a healthcare facility or department. This role ensures efficient and effective delivery of healthcare services by coordinating various departments, managing resources, and implementing strategies to optimize operational performance. The Operations Manager plays a critical role in enhancing patient care, streamlining processes, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.

Job Types: Part\-time, Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Naktala, Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Operations: 1 year (Preferred)
* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
